propositions: A new peer confirmation evidence store must record each successfully applied outbound link with vendor link id, direction, pass id, and timestamp to distinguish never-pushed local links from peer-deleted ones.
The confirmation record key is the tuple (source_local_id, target_local_id, relation) and must be relation-scoped to match inbound unlink semantics.
The write point is after set_relationship succeeds in dispatch_one.py; callback exceptions must be logged and swallowed to prevent confirmation failures from breaking already-applied outbound links.
Unbound targets (when binding_store.get_local_id returns None) must skip recording entirely rather than persisting vendor keys in local-id fields.
The peer_confirmations.json file must be tracked in both _rel_files and _tracked_basenames so confirmation-only changes are committed and survive snapshot compaction.
Corrupt or absent peer_confirmations.json must degrade to an empty store without aborting the reconciliation pass.
